# GoTax.SI

> GoTax.SI explains IRS notices in plain language: upload a photo or PDF of an IRS letter and get a bilingual explanation of what it means, what the IRS is asking, when it is due and what you can do.

GoTax.SI is not a law firm and is not affiliated with the IRS. Explanations are general information, not legal or tax advice. SSN/ITIN and bank account numbers are redacted before analysis, and uploaded files are auto-deleted after 90 days. Prices are fixed in USD, payable by Bitcoin (on-chain or Lightning) or by card/bank.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.gotax.si/): Overview of the IRS notice explanation service, how it works, pricing summary and FAQs.
- [Notice Decoder](https://www.gotax.si/decoder.html): Upload a JPG, PNG or PDF of an IRS notice (max 15 MB) or paste the text to get a bilingual, plain-language explanation with deadlines, options and next steps.
- [Pricing](https://www.gotax.si/pricing.html): Fixed prices in USD and Bitcoin, what each explanation includes, and payment methods.
- [Tax return preparation](https://www.gotax.si/returns.html): Guided intake with OCR-prefilled forms; a licensed US CPA/EA reviews, signs and files the return.
- [Contact & help](https://www.gotax.si/contact.html): Contact form and help centre. Do not send SSNs, bank details or full documents through this form.

- [CP501](https://www.gotax.si/notices/cp501.html): CP501 notice explained in plain language.

## Languages

Every explanation is shown in English and the reader's chosen language, side by side. Supported languages (12): English, Spanish, Hindi, Bangla, Arabic, Swahili, German, Korean, Tagalog, French, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. Select a language with the `?lang=` query parameter, for example https://www.gotax.si/?lang=bn — codes: `hi`, `bn`, `ar`, `sw`, `es`, `de`, `ko`, `tl`, `fr`, `zh-CN`, `zh-TW` (English is the default). Translations are machine-assisted; the English version controls.
